findings.claim: Attributes already on the formatted type T are ignored. GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect never reads T's attributes: without a surrogate it always builds contractless string-key members from every public read-write member. So [DataContract]/[DataMember] (Project A can use these without a MessagePack reference), and [MessagePackObject]/[Key]/[IgnoreMember] on T, are not honoured. A member marked [IgnoreMember] or left out of a [DataContract] is still serialized under its CLR name. This breaks the acceptance criterion 'If T does carry MessagePack attributes, they are honoured' and the maintainer's 'If there are attributes on it, fine, we'll use them'.

receipt_plan.detail: Run tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/Receipts/GeneratedFormatterHonoursTypeAttributesTests.cs: DataContractOnReferencedType_IsHonoured and IgnoreMemberOnReferencedType_IsHonoured. Both fail on head because the generated MyTypeFormatter body still references 'Secret'.

findings.claim: Because attributes on T are never consulted, a T that carries [Union] (an abstract base with union cases) is rejected outright with MsgPack021. The rejection happens in the IsAbstract/TypeKind check. The requirement names Union among the settings to support and asks for T's MessagePack attributes to be honoured.

receipt_plan.detail: GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs:64-74 returns MsgPack021 for any abstract or interface T before any attribute on T is read. Union attributes are never examined.

findings.claim: 'Contractless behaviour over public members' is narrowed to public read-write members with a parameterless constructor. Getter-only public properties are dropped from serialization. Types whose only constructor takes parameters are rejected with MsgPack007-style NoDeserializingConstructor. The existing contractless resolver serializes all public readable members and matches constructor parameters. Whether this narrowing is acceptable depends on how 'contractless behaviour' is read.

receipt_plan.detail: Use ContractlessStandardResolver (base) and the head-generated formatter to serialize the same instance of a type with a public get-only property (e.g. `public int Total => 3;`). The base map contains 'Total'; the head map omits it.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Contractless means the public, read-write instance properties and fields only, deserialized through an accessible parameterless constructor. CreateContractlessMembers filters with IsPublicReadWrite. Collect rejects classes that lack a parameterless constructor. Getter-only members are not serialized.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless means the same member set as the existing ContractlessStandardResolver. Every public readable instance property and field is serialized, and getter-only ones are emitted with IsWritable: false. Deserialization matches constructor parameters by name into constructorParameters instead of passing Array.Empty. The minimal edit relaxes IsPublicReadWrite to public-readable in CreateContractlessMembers and adds constructor matching in place of the parameterless-constructor check at GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs:77.
